decisive_items: Gram stain revealed gram-positive cocci in chains
development of hypopyon and increased fibrinous material emanating from the iris lesion
response.rationale: The clinical presentation of acute anterior chamber inflammation with hypopyon after a dental procedure, combined with gram-positive cocci in chains and culture-proven Streptococcus intermedius, most strongly supports streptococcal endophthalmitis. The branching gram-positive rods were not further identified and do not override the culture-confirmed streptococcal cause.
